paperInfo.subject: Chishona
paperInfo.paperName: Grade 7 Chishona Paper 1 - Expanded Exam Bank
paperInfo.paperType: Practice question bank (original ZIMSEC-style multiple choice)

questions.questionText: Verenga: “Mvura yakakosha kuhupenyu. Vanhu vanofanira kuchengetedza nzizi nematsime.” Chii chinofanira kuitwa nevanhu?
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Kuchengetedza nzizi nematsime.”. To protect rivers and wells.

questions.questionText: Sarudza izwi rine dudziro yakafanana nerekuti “mufaro”.
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “mufarwa”. happiness/joy
Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “pfupi”. short
Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “chikoro”. school

questions.questionText: Mumutsara unoti “Vana vari kuverenga mabhuku”, izwi rokuti “Vana” rinonzi chii?
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Chitsigiro/chiito chepamusoro (subject)”. subject
Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “anomhanya”. runs

questions.questionText: “Vana vakatamba bhora.” Chiito chiri panguva ipi?
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Nguva yakapfuura”. past tense

questions.questionText: Chii chinorehwa nemutsara unoti “Tichaenda kuchikoro mangwana”?
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Tichenda kuchikoro mangwana.”. We will go to school tomorrow.
Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Chisazitasingwi”. pronoun
Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Rinotsanangura musikana.”. It describes the girl.

questions.questionText: Nderipi izwi rinoratidza nzvimbo mumutsara “Bhuku riri patafura”?
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “patafura”. on the table

questions.questionText: “Iri bhuku rangu.” Izwi rokuti “iri” rinoshandiswa sei?
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Kuratidza chinhu chiri pedyo.”. To point out something nearby.
Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “vana”. children
Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Tendai”. Tendai
Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Harare”. Harare

questions.questionText: Nderipi izwi rinonyanya kushandiswa kubvunza nezvemunhu?
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “ndiani”. who
Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “riini”. when
Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “kupi”. where
Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “sei”. why/how

questions.questionText: “Kurova imbwa wakabata muswe” kunorevei muchirevo chakajairika?

options.text: Kuita chinhu nenzira isina kunaka kana kukanganisa nzira yakakodzera.

questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Kuita chinhu nenzira isina kunaka kana kukanganisa nzira yakakodzera.”. Doing something in an improper way.
Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “churu”. an anthill

questions.questionText: “Chara chimwe hachitswanyi inda.” Chidzidzo chikuru chacho ndechei?
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Kushanda pamwe chete kunobatsira.”. Working together helps.

options.text: Munhu anofanira kutaura kana aine dambudziko kuti abatsirwe.

questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Munhu anofanira kutaura kana aine dambudziko kuti abatsirwe.”. One should speak up to receive help.

questions.questionText: Sei zvakakosha kuremekedza vakuru mutsika dzechiShona?
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Kunoratidza hunhu uye kuchengetedza tsika.”. It shows good character and preserves culture.

questions.questionText: Ndeipi kwaziso yakakodzera kumunhu mukuru mangwanani?
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Mangwanani, makadini?”. Good morning, how are you?

questions.questionText: Ndeupi unhu hunoratidzwa nekubatsira munhu ari mudambudziko?
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Hunyoro netsitsi”. kindness and compassion

options.text: Basa remutauro rinorongwa nemitsara richishandisa mutinhimira nemifananidzo yemashoko.

questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Basa remutauro rinorongwa nemitsara richishandisa mutinhimira nemifananidzo yemashoko.”. Poetry using organised lines, rhythm and imagery.

options.text: Pfungwa huru kana chidzidzo chinotaurwa nenyaya.

questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Pfungwa huru kana chidzidzo chinotaurwa nenyaya.”. Main idea/theme or lesson.

questions.questionText: Munhu anowanikwa achiita zviitiko zvikuru munyaya anonzi ani?
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Gamba/mutambi mukuru”. main character

questions.questionText: Ndeipi inonyanya kukodzera kutanga tsamba yeshamwari?
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Shamwari yangu Tawanda,”. My friend Tawanda,

questions.questionText: Kana uchipa mashoko pamberi peboka, ndechipi chinonyanya kukosha?
questions.explanation: Mhinduro yakarurama ndeye “Kutaura zvakajeka uye nechivimbo.”. Speak clearly and confidently.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Tsumo inoti 'Mviromviro yemhanza mapfeka'. Zvinoreva kuti zvinhu zvikuru kana zvakaipa zvinotanga zvishoma zvishoma.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Tsumo inoti 'Kandiro kanoenda kunobva kamwe'. Inotidzidzisa tsika yekubatsirana nekudyidzana nekuwadzana nevavakidzani.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Tsumo inoti 'Totenda maruva tadya chakata'. Inoreva kuti usafare nezviratidzo zvisati zvabereka zvibereko chaizvo zvinobatika.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Tsumo inoti 'Aive madziva ava mazambuko'. Zvinoreva kuti upenyu hunochinja, akanga ari mupfumi anogona kuva murombo kana kuti zvinhu zvakanga zvakaoma zvinoita nyore.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Tsumo inoti 'Chakafukidza dzimba matenga'. Zvinoreva kuti zvinoitika mumhuri zvemukati hazvizivikanwe nevanhu vekunze.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Tsumo inoti 'Nzombe huru yakabva mumhuru'. Zvinoreva kuti munhu wese ane mukurumbira akatanga ari mudiki asingazivikanwe.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Tsumo inoreva kuti munhu anobudirira kuburikidza nekushandira pamwe kana kuwana rubatsiro kubva kune vamwe.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Zvinoreva kuti munhu paanotambudzika pamberi pevamwe anenge achitsvaga rubatsiro.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Munhu mumwe chete haakwanisi kuita basa rinoda vanhu vakawanda ari ega.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Kunyange zvinhu zvisingaoneki nameso zvinogona kunzwika nezvenhau.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Chengeta vana zvakanaka kuti mangwana vakure vachizokuchengetawo paucheche hwako.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Munhu anobata basa nesimba haashaye chidiki chinomuraramisa muupenyu.

questions.questionText: Pedzisa tsumo inoti: “Gudo guru peta muswe...”
questions.explanation: ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Mukuru anofanira kuzvininipisa kuitira kuti ave muenzaniso wakanaka kuvadiki.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Kunonoka kuita sarudzo panguva yakakodzera kunogona kuunza njodzi huru.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Munhu anozvipinza mumatambudziko nekuda kwemashoko anobuda mumuromo make.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Kunyange uchiremekedzwa kumusha kwenyu, kune imwe nzvimbo uri munhuwo zvake.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Kuva nemaitiro akatsiga nekungwarira kunoita kuti usakurumidza kuwira munjodzi.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Siya zvinhu zvimboibva pachinzvimbo chekumhanyira zvisati zvagadzirira.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Usatuka kana kuseka munhu ane chirema nekuti iwe unogona kuzosanganawo nenhamo.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Munhu azvipira kuita basa akaoma anofanira kutarisana nematambudziko aro asina kugunun'una.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Koshesa mukana wese waunowana nekuti unogona kusazouya zvakare.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Mhosva kana chakaipa chakaitwa hachingovhiringidzwe nenguva chiripo kusvikira charipwa.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Kudemba kunouya mushure mekunge zvinhu zvatosakara kana kuparara.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Munhu asina musoro netsika haana tsitsi kana nehukama hwake.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Vanhu vanotevedzera zvinoitwa nevamwe vavo vanotungamira.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Zvinhu zvinochinja nenguva; mazuva ano haana kufanana neakapfuura.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Kubudirira chero kupi zvako kunotanga kubva panzvimbo yakaderera kwazvo.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Munhu anotaura nyaya yenjodzi chete kana akwanisa kupukunyuka mairi.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Kuitira mutsa munhu asina rutendo kunogona kuzokukonzera nhamo kumberi.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Munhu anopihwa rubatsiro asingatendi akafanana nemuroyi anorwisa vanhu.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Mabasa anorema anoda kubatana kwevanhu vakawanda kuitira kuti akurumidze kupera.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Munhu haafaniri kupomera vamwe mhosva iye achiita zvimwe chete zvakashata.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Kumhanyira kuita zvinhu usina kuronga kunounza kunonoka nekurasikirwa.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Matambudziko anounzwa nekuzvisarudzira kwemunhu haafaniri kuchemerwa kune vamwe.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Vanhu vakawanda vakaita musangano vasina mutungamiri akasimba vanopedzisira vasina chabuda.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Munhu anoita zvisakarurama achivimba nekuti ane mutsigiri ane simba kumashure kwake.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Nhamo inouya kune munhu asina wekumurwira kana mutsigiri.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Munhu akaderera haaregererwi zviri nyore kana akanganisa.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Kana munhu asina kutaura zviri kumunetsa hakuna anoziva zvekuita kuti amubatsire.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Munhu haatadzi kutakura matambudziko emhuri yake kana vana vake.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Munhu anenge achitsvaga chimwe chinhu anozvininipisa, asi akachiona anozvikudza.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Kuti munhu azonakidzwa nehupenyu anofanira kutanga ashanda nesimba nekutamburira hupenyu hwacho.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Sekuru munhu akakosha kwazvo muupenyu hwechivanhu nekuda kwezano nekuyananisa.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Kutsamwa pasina zano hakuna kwakunombosvitsa munhu.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Munhu anenge apedza basa rake anongozorora kana kuenda zvake.
ZIMSEC Chishona Tsananguro: Tsumo inoti 'Chara chimwe hachitswanyi inda'. Zvinoreva kuti munhu mumwe chete haagoni kuita basa guru ari ega; vanhu vanofanira kubatsirana (mushandirapamwe).
